Service terms and risks

Wallet credits and crypto withdrawals

A scheduled credit is an entry in your 12x12 USD wallet. An approved withdrawal is settled separately by the cashier from the operator’s crypto wallet. The quote shows the asset, network, amount and fee. Availability depends on the cashier’s review and ability to settle.

Plans and paydays

The current plan terms are shown on the Plans page. Wallet credits skip weekends and observed U.S. federal holidays in UTC. The plan term runs for the stated number of paydays.

Transfer risks

Crypto payments can be irreversible. Confirm the network and receiving address before sending. The cashier checks a transfer against its quote before crediting the wallet. Get help with an unmatched transfer through the site’s support tools.

Operator and formal terms

The operator’s legal identity, jurisdiction and formal terms have not been supplied for this release package. This page describes how the service works.
